from tools import filter_hotels, filter_restaurants, search_nearest, save_to_cache

# Retrieve cached hotel results
hotels_result = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels2")

# Retrieve cached restaurant results
restaurants_result = get_results_from_cache(key="filtered_restaurants")

# Filter hotels based on amenities: gym and laundry service
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels_result,
    gym_present=True,
    has_laundry_service=True
)

# Save filtered hotel results
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Filter restaurants based on cuisine and rating
filtered_restaurants = filter_restaurants(
    prior_results=restaurants_result,
    cuisine=["Chinese"],
    rating=[3.5, 5.0]
)

# Save filtered restaurant results
save_to_cache(key="filtered_restaurants", value=filtered_restaurants)

# Find nearest attractions based on hotels and restaurants
nearest_results = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    restaurants=filtered_restaurants,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save nearest results
save_to_cache(key="nearest_results", value=nearest_results)
